description:
This is an SMB (Super Mario Bros) Tileset for an Land Level
The Zip File Contains:
-ExGFX00
-Test Level
-Map 16 Page
-Map 16 PageG
-The Palette
An ExGFX Tutorial for noobs who don,t even know how to add those Graphics (very useful 4 newbies)

-Readme with notes of my tileset and screenshots
and a bitmap of the Test Level to see the tiles and that the palette looks right.
ENJOY!
